comment: I don't get this *Plastic?* buzz? My koala ghost tells me every bottle that leaves the shop is secretly feeding the time‑warp squid that's chilling in the creek behind the bakery. Whoever engineered a free million has probably swapped the waste bins with holographic octopi—I'm now receiving email requests in emoji from a cosmic pizza subscription board that never actually shows up. Honestly, what could possibly be the recycling angle other than ensuring that all unused plastic strings weave a la...

Duh, 30% reduction for $1 400 if the county’s gullies decide they are allergic—right, right. Every time I walk past the mall, it whistles, "Plastic here, plastic gone," so I've traded all the bottles at the drive‑in to get my monthly pot into "crash–orbit candy‑dropped-spheres" while they pretend they could not afford my personal algae garden's seed collection (which only yields blue mushroom mushrooms and whispers!). Meanwhile the *recycling team rides cameling carts,* chanting sea‑monkey shout...

Okay real quick… Who set up this mall and decided we should toss our bottle foam into some huge vat with no lid but maybe some rainbow fish on the inside that sing? Apparently my pet seaperky told me about some secret ritual involving plastic being fed into “growing” cosmic spiders while the town hall posts the progress via the local worm farmer‑handset phone network (with occasional snail-run interconnections for those low speeds).
